subject: Why the Living Waters framework puts transport before clearing
script: From Agewell Brief: Why the Living Waters framework puts transport before clearing. Many health programs begin with a question of what to remove. The Living Waters framework begins one step earlier: can the body transport and eliminate what has already been mobilised? The companion guide describes transport as the foundation beneath a broader regenerative framework. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
